mission_page.title: Turning frontier AI & Robotics into everyday reality.
mission_page.lead: I understand emerging technologies deeply, connect them with real human needs, and build products, systems, and organizations people can actually use.
mission_page.purpose_title: Turn technological progress into lived progress.
mission_page.purpose_body: Move the achievements of AI & Robotics beyond papers and corporate milestones into meaningful changes in how people live and work.
mission_page.vision_title: A world where frontier technology becomes an everyday capability.
mission_page.vision_body: The most advanced capabilities in AI & Robotics become useful, trusted, and ordinary parts of everyday life and work.
mission_page.mission_title: Build what is missing between frontier technology and real needs.
mission_page.mission_body: Study and test the technology firsthand, identify consequential real-world problems, and build the products, systems, and organizations that connect the two.
